title: Snap Makes Its Case for Wearing A Computer On Your Face
description: Snap revealed new details and software capabilities for its Specs augmented reality glasses during a presentation led by CEO Evan Spiegel. Mark Gurman and Chris Welch got to try them on and try them out. Here's what they think (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Snap Shares More Details About $2,195 Specs AR Glasses, Plus Verizon Partnership
description: The technically advanced Specs feature an integrated display and a convenient self-contained design.

title: Apple’s Cook, OpenAI CEO to Attend Trump Dinner With Xi
description: Apple Inc. Executive Chairman Tim Cook and OpenAI Chief Executive Officer Sam Altman are poised to attend a White House state dinner for Chinese President Xi Jinping next week.
